verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs once described Triggers: a consumer activated a trigger through Smithery, Smithery proxied the subscribe call to the MCP server, and the server POSTed events directly to the consumer. That would have replaced polling. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice (same first-party tier, so this is not a cross-tier dispute) says the Smithery API, Connect, accounts, CLI and SDKs stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that Smithery now remains only a non-proxied registry, so the trigger subscription path it documented no longer exists.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
